symptom: cam-02 (RTSP) never produced a frame: 'Service Maker produced no valid stdout frame metadata within the startup deadline'; both publisher logs: 'Connection to tcp://172.17.0.1:8554 failed: Connection refused'.
cause: The test RTSP server (mediamtx) never started: no mediamtx.pid and no mediamtx.log were written. spawn() ran `wsl.exe -e setsid bash -c ...`; plain setsid forks when it is a process-group leader, so wsl.exe returned at once and the detached child raced the WSL session teardown. Reproduced in isolation: wsl.exe had exited (rc 0) while the pid file appeared only after 4.0 s. The validator then slept a fixed 2 s and never checked that the server was listening.
not_the_cause: Not the extractor pacing change and not the product RTSP path: the same product code passed 25/25 once the server was up.
fix: scripts/validate_rtsp_source.py: spawn() uses `setsid --wait` (wsl.exe stays attached until the process exits; kill_owned already waits for it), and a new check rtsp_test_server_listening waits up to 60 s for the pid file and a TCP connect to 172.17.0.1:8554; if it never listens the run records FAIL and still writes result.json after cleanup.
